description: Monolithic Power Systems MP1584EN — 3 A step-down (buck) converter, 4.5-28 V in → 0.8-25 V out, 1.5 MHz fixed switching. SOIC-8 with exposed thermal pad. The maker default for step-down rails when AMS1117 would dissipate too much heat (e.g., 12 V → 5 V or 9 V → 3.3 V at >300 mA). Used in countless ebay/Amazon mini-buck modules.
name: mp1584en
watch_out_for: Vfb is 0.8 V — output divider sets Vout = 0.8 × (1 + Rtop/Rbot). Exposed pad MUST be soldered to a copper pour with ≥2 thermal vias to ground or the part derates hard above 1 A. Inductor: 10-22 µH (depends on Vout and ripple), rated ≥4 A peak. Output cap: 22 µF low-ESR (X5R/X7R). Bootstrap cap (10 nF) between BS and SW is required for the high-side gate driver. Hard 28 V input ceiling — for higher voltage step up to MP2315 (24 V) or MP2307 (28 V improved) or use a transformer pre-stage.
